purpose: Quantify uncertainty around external calibration, test within-source assay-specific recalibration feasibility without changing the frozen model, and localize false-positive and false-negative error patterns.

cross_fitting.splitter: GroupKFold with bootstrap_cluster groups, shuffle and seed 20260805
cross_fitting.note: Calibrators are fitted only on four folds and scored on the held-out fold, but all folds come from the same outcome-observed Biogen source.

calibration_diagnostics.brier_decomposition: 10 adaptive bins; reliability, resolution, uncertainty, and binning residual

error_taxonomy.tests: Mann-Whitney U, Cliff delta, standardized mean difference, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each comparison; exploratory only

scaffold_hotspots.shrinkage: Beta-binomial posterior mean with prior strength 10 centered on the population error rate

interpretation_rules.allowed: External calibration uncertainty, within-source assay-specific recalibration feasibility, and descriptive error localization.
interpretation_rules.not_allowed: Calling cross-fitted Biogen recalibration an independent external validation, replacing the frozen model, selecting a new threshold, or claiming an absolute universal ABCB1 substrate probability.
